maria_csm: Quick post-onboard check for NewCo private VPC — noticed two items that need follow-up: audit forwarding to our ingest cluster isn't showing new logs, and their KMS key policy looks permissive. Can we triage? cc @alex_infra @sam_security @devon_eng

alex_infra: I can take a look. Are they on shared VPC or host project topology? I want to confirm route propagation first.

devon_eng: They landed on a host-project setup. Saw routes from their side but our egress collector isn't receiving traffic. I think the cloud-router -> NAT rules didn't propagate.

alex_infra: Got it. I’ll check BGP sessions and the cloud-router status. If routes are missing, likely a peering import/export issue.

devon_eng: Pasting the relevant route output I pulled from their project:
```
NAME: route-privnet-egress
DEST_RANGE: 0.0.0.0/0
NEXT_HOP: ilb-newco-001
PRIORITY: 1000
NETWORK: projects/newco-host/global/networks/privnet
```
Seems fine on their side but our collector's firewall rules deny 10.12.0.0/16 -> collector subnet.

sam_security: On KMS: their key IAM binding currently includes a broad principal (they used a test group). We need to tighten to service accounts only and enable key rotation. Example diff I suggest: replace "allAuthenticatedUsers" with the specific `serviceAccount:newco-audit@newco.iam.gserviceaccount.com`. Also enable CMEK enforcement on storage sinks.

sre_bot: alert: audit-forwarder/newco-forwarder returned 503 (last 3 checks) — logs: `Error: unable to POST /ingest: upstream 503` (03:12 UTC).

alex_infra: Plan: I’ll open a peering troubleshooting runbook, confirm BGP and route import/export, and relax collector firewall briefly for smoke. Devon, can you restart the forwarder after firewall change?

devon_eng: Yep. I’ll restart the forwarder and tail logs. If you open the temporary firewall rule, use: `gcloud compute firewall-rules create allow-newco-collector --network=privnet --allow=tcp:9000 --source-ranges=10.12.0.0/16 --priority=65534` then revert after smoke.

maria_csm: Action items: (1) @alex_infra verify peering/routes and open temp firewall, (2) @devon_eng restart forwarder + confirm log delivery, (3) @sam_security propose concrete KMS binding change and rotation schedule. If these aren’t resolved in 2 weeks we should mark renewal risk for this seat (audit/compliance blocker). I’ll draft a short enablement playbook with steps and handoff notes.

devon_eng: Ack — will post logs here after restart.

sam_security: Ack — will push a policy PR and leave comments for NewCo to approve.

maria_csm: Thanks team — I’ll follow up after the smoke test and attach the playbook. :thumbsup:
